title: FUKUSHIMA 2011
sub: 6 मीटर की तैयारी, 15 मीटर की लहर
en: The plant was built for a six-metre wave. The wave that came was fifteen metres high.
11 March 2011. A magnitude 9 earthquake in Japan.
The Fukushima nuclear plant's reactors shut down automatically.
Then, about fifty minutes later, a wave rose from the sea.
A wave fourteen to fifteen metres high came over the sea wall into the plant.
Water filled the basements, where the emergency generators stood.
One by one, all the generators stopped.
And the pumps that kept the reactors cool stopped.
What happened next? The full story is on the channel. Subscribe.
